survey.source: https://repology.org/project/gimp/versions and https://repology.org/project/python:pygobject/versions, then confirmed in the containers below
survey.requirement: GIMP >= 3.2 with Python 3 plug-ins (PyGObject + the Gimp-3.0 typelib)

distributions.name: Arch Linux
distributions.install: pacman -Syu --noconfirm --needed gimp python python-gobject ca-certificates && pacman -Scc --noconfirm

distributions.name: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
distributions.install: apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gimp python3-gi gir1.2-gimp-3.0 ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

distributions.name: Debian 14 "forky" (testing)
distributions.install: apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gimp python3-gi gir1.2-gimp-3.0 ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

distributions.name: Fedora 44
distributions.install: dnf install -y --setopt=install_weak_deps=False gimp python3-gobject shadow-utils && dnf clean all

distributions.name: openSUSE Tumbleweed
distributions.install: zypper --non-interactive install --no-recommends gimp python313 python313-gobject shadow && zypper clean -a

distributions.name: Alpine Linux 3.24
distributions.install: apk add --no-cache gimp py3-gobject3 python3 ca-certificates
